nodes.label: Access-Kit v0.1 Python Core Implementation Plan
Zero Classes Constraint
nodes.rationale: Only Exception, NamedTuple, TypedDict and pydantic BaseSettings allowed; everything else is closures and plain functions.

nodes.label: Latest Stable Python 3 Policy
nodes.rationale: Fixed-version examples superseded by CI 3.x with check-latest: true.

nodes.label: jscpd Zero-Tolerance Duplicate Check
nodes.rationale: Drives extraction of complete_json_with_retry so providers do not duplicate retry logic.

nodes.label: SSRF Validation at Every Redirect Hop
nodes.rationale: Each redirect target IP is re-resolved and validated before connecting; redirects followed manually.

nodes.label: DNS Rebinding Defense via IP Pinning
nodes.rationale: No custom transport class; httpx with rewritten IP URL, Host header and sni_hostname extension.

nodes.label: Tox Envs py-test / py-typecheck / py-no-classes
nodes.rationale: Defined early, added to env_list only in Task 15.

nodes.label: AccessKitSettings
nodes.rationale: pydantic-settings BaseSettings; missing public_base_url, redis_url, session_secret raises ValidationError at startup.

nodes.label: get_session_id
nodes.rationale: Constant-time HMAC compare; tampered cookie returns None rather than raising.

nodes.label: HMAC-Signed Stateless Session Cookie (ak_sid)
nodes.rationale: Session state in cookies, HMAC-signed without itsdangerous.

nodes.label: is_blocked_ip
nodes.rationale: Fails closed: malformed input (octal/hex/decimal) is blocked; IPv4-mapped IPv6 unwrapped.

nodes.label: Safe Fetch Exceptions (BlockedDestination, TooLarge, BadContentType, TooManyRedirects, FetchTimeout)
make_fetcher
nodes.rationale: Returns (fetch, download) closures; download is non-streaming (shortcut: switch to client.stream() if memory pressure).

nodes.label: LLMProvider TypedDict
nodes.rationale: Provider as dict of closures instead of a class.

nodes.label: complete_json_with_retry
nodes.rationale: Shared across providers to satisfy jscpd; raises LLMValidationError after max_retries.

nodes.label: Subagent-Driven Execution Recommendation
nodes.rationale: 15 mostly independent tasks; per-task review catches errors before propagation in a security-critical library.
